tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches live rental-car offers for a pickup location and rental period, optionally with a different dropoff location, pickup/dropoff times, driver age, currency, and language. Use this when the user wants to compare available rental cars, prices, vendors, categories, or booking links for a specific trip. Do not use it for flights, hotels, public transport, or general travel planning unless the user has car-rental intent. The tool queries external provider APIs in real time, returns price-ranked results grouped by SIPP/category, and may include affiliate booking links. It does not book cars, modify reservations, charge users, or store user data.

location.description: Pickup location, such as a city, airport, station, address, or landmark.
location.title: Location

pickup_date.description: Pickup date. Accepts common date formats such as YYYY-MM-DD, DD.MM.YYYY, or natural-language dates.
pickup_date.title: Pickup Date

dropoff_date.description: Dropoff date. Must be after the pickup date.
dropoff_date.title: Dropoff Date

dropoff_location.description: Optional different dropoff location. If omitted, the pickup location is used.
dropoff_location.title: Dropoff Location

pickup_time.description: Pickup time in 24-hour HH:MM format. Defaults to 12:00.
pickup_time.title: Pickup Time

dropoff_time.description: Dropoff time in 24-hour HH:MM format. Defaults to 12:00.
dropoff_time.title: Dropoff Time

currency.description: Preferred ISO 4217 currency code for prices, such as EUR, USD, or GBP. Defaults to EUR.
currency.title: Currency

language.description: Preferred response language code, such as en or de. Defaults to en.
language.title: Language

age.description: Driver age. Defaults to 30. Younger drivers may incur surcharges.
age.title: Age
